title_en: Here's Every GTA 6 Side Activity We've Spotted So Far
summary_en: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6: Extended Look has shown off almost 30 minutes of GTA 6 footage, and among the lengthy clips of missions, we've also seen some of the side activities you'll likely spend hours getting distracted by.
body_en:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6: Extended Look has shown off almost 30 minutes of GTA 6 footage, and among the lengthy clips of missions, we've also seen some of the side activities you'll likely spend hours getting distracted by.
Some of these look to be full mini-games, such as a clip of a rally racing track we were treated to at one point, while others just look to be fun extras you can just do for the hell of it — such as acquiring base-jumping equipment and leaping off very tall buildings.

For all of the biggest reveals from tonight's Extended Look, be sure to catch up with our GTA 6 reveal live blog , as well as our full preview coverage from IGN's own trip to see Grand Theft Auto 6 , exclusive interview with Rockstar , and 69 GTA 6 details we learned during our visit .
